name: Slider
summary: Picks a number, a range or several numbers on one track by dragging or with the keys, where trying values and seeing the result at once matters more than an exact figure (a font axis, a price band, a volume). Marks draw a scale (graduated); `step` or `restrictToMarks` quantise it. Not for a value that must be typed exactly (pair a NumberField or use one alone) or for an on/off choice (use Switch). Shares of a whole use AllocationSlider.
a11y: Each thumb is a `slider` named by the label (one thumb) or its `thumbLabels` entry, with `aria-valuemin`, `aria-valuemax` (dependent on its neighbours), `aria-valuenow` and `aria-valuetext` from `format`. Tab order is by thumb, never by position. Marks and bounds are written text, so the scale is never colour or position alone.

keys.action: by one step (or to the next mark); Page Up / Page Down or Shift + arrows: by a large step; Home / End: as far as the thumb may go. Right and left swap in right-to-left text.

props.name: label
props.description: What the value is, in a few words, e.g. "Weight". Shown above the track unless `hideLabel`; always the accessible name.

props.name: hideLabel
props.description: Hides the visible label where a heading or row already says what it is. It still names the slider.

props.name: value
props.description: One number for one thumb; two numbers for a range; three or more for independent thumbs on one track.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called on every change while dragging or pressing keys, with a number for one thumb or the array for several.

props.name: onChangeEnd
props.description: Called once on release or key-up with the final value: save here, never in `onChange`.

props.name: step
props.description: The smallest change; the arrow keys move by this and drags snap to it.

props.name: largeStep
props.description: Page Up / Page Down and Shift + arrows move by this many steps.

props.name: marks
props.description: Ticks on the track: `true` draws one per step (when 50 or fewer); a list draws only those, each with an optional label.

props.name: restrictToMarks
props.description: Only the marked values can be chosen (non-uniform steps such as plan tiers). Needs `marks` as a list.

props.name: valueLabel
props.description: A bubble over the thumb with its value: never, while dragging, hovered or focused (`active`), or `always`.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Writes the value beside the label; on by default, off when a paired number box already shows it.

props.name: showBounds
props.description: Writes the minimum and maximum under the track's ends.

props.name: format
props.description: Says a value the way a person reads it ("14 px", "€40", "Monday"); used everywhere the value is shown and announced.

props.name: valueText
props.description: The value as read, for one thumb; prefer `format`.

props.name: size
props.description: Track and thumb: s (dense editors; 24 px target), normal (forms; 44 px) or l (touch and media; 48 px).

props.name: startIcon
props.description: A small icon before the track saying what low means (quiet, dark, smaller).

props.name: endIcon
props.description: A small icon after the track saying what high means.

props.name: origin
props.description: Where the fill starts for one thumb, e.g. 0 on −100…100 (balance, exposure); `min` when left out.

props.name: scale
props.description: How position maps to value: `linear`, or `log` for ranges over several orders of magnitude (20 Hz–20 kHz).

props.name: minGap
props.description: The closest two neighbouring thumbs may come.

props.name: collide
props.description: When a thumb meets its neighbour: `block` stops it (default); `push` moves the neighbour along.

props.name: dragRange
props.description: With two thumbs, dragging the fill between them moves the whole range and keeps its width.

props.name: input
props.description: A NumberField per thumb for exact entry (one or two thumbs): after the track, or one at each end for a range.

props.name: unit
props.description: The unit typed and shown in the paired NumberField, e.g. "px", "%".

props.name: thumbLabels
props.description: Each thumb's own name when there are several, e.g. ["Minimum price", "Maximum price"].

props.name: description
props.description: One line under the track that helps choose a value.

props.name: error
props.description: What is wrong with the value and how to fix it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The value can't change and needn't be read. Prefer `readOnly`, or say why in the description.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: The value is shown and can be focused but not changed.
